notes.title: Lost Luminosity
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Lost Luminosity - A new horror game![/b][/h1]

[b]Guys, many thanks to everyone who has already added it to the wishlist! 

Your support is incredibly important to me and I really appreciate your interest in my project! It is thanks to you that I continue to work on the game and try to make it even better. 

Thank you![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603100/Lost_Luminosity/

notes.title: Patch 1.9.4.0
notes.notes:
1. Optimization of actions when searching for objects

2. Added more visual cues

3. Increased range and intensity of the glow stick light

notes.title: Thank you for your contribution!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear friends![/b].

I would like to extend a huge thank you to each and every one of you for your active participation and valuable feedback on my recent project. Your opinion is incredibly important to me and I am grateful for every thought, every recommendation and every comment.

I am well aware that no project is perfect, and as such, I greatly appreciate your honest and constructive criticism. I have carefully studied all your comments, videos and streamings, paid attention to the flaws and problems you wrote and talked about. All of them have been taken into account.

In future projects I will do my best to correct mistakes, eliminate defects and realize your wishes. Thanks to your support and feedback, I am constantly growing as a developer and strive to create products that will please you.

Once again, thank you so much for your support and faith in me! Together we will make future projects even better.
 
Sincerely, [b]Ember Wing Games[/b]
